pattern.short_summary: A persistent region sits beside the surface the user is working on and shows generated content derived from that surface's current state.
pattern.definition: A persistent region sits beside the surface the user is working on and shows generated content derived from that surface's current state. It refreshes on its own as the work changes rather than when the user asks. The panel is not the artifact under construction; it is a running commentary on it.
pattern.structural_signature: Two co-present regions with an asymmetric dependency: region A holds the user-authored state, region B renders a derived generation, and B is recomputed as a side effect of changes to A with no invocation step. B is typically read-only or non-committal — its content does not enter the artifact unless the user acts. The adjacency is spatial (margin, sidebar, docked panel) so that A and B are read together.

dimension.category_description: When assistance appears and who triggers it: system-initiated, continuous, deferred, session-bound, or explicitly summoned.
dimension.classification_boundary: The timing or trigger must be observable in the interaction; surface placement alone belongs to U09.
